description: Source code for handling Avro serialization and reporting of extender associated devices, including schema loading, data preparation, and webpa message sending.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaBuffer
methods.description: Returns the buffer containing the IDW schema.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IDW schema buffer.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaIDBuffer
methods.description: Returns the schema ID buffer string.

methods.name: GetIDWSchemaIDBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the length of the schema ID buffer string.

methods.name: NumberofElementsinIDWLinkedList
methods.description: Counts the number of elements in the linked list of associated device data.

methods.name: NumberofDevicesinIDWLinkedList
methods.description: Counts the total number of associated devices in the linked list.

methods.name: prepare_writer_idw
methods.description: Prepares an Avro writer with schema loaded from file or cache.

methods.name: extender_report_associateddevices
methods.description: Serializes associated device data into Avro format, encodes in base64, and sends via WebPA.

methods.name: idw_avro_cleanup
methods.description: Frees allocated resources related to IDW Avro serialization.
